functional_safety_rules.description: A missing value is never interpreted as zero or as a negative assay result.
An unvalidated rule cannot produce a favorable automated output.
Source results are preserved before any longitudinal description.
A simplified-review candidate still requires explicit human confirmation.

proposed_medical_rules.description: Age strictly above 65 contributes one point.
Pregnancy count uses the proposed 0, 1, 2 contribution tiers.
Transfusion count uses proposed tiers; regular frequency is undefined.
